title: Kissed with Spicy Thai Chicken Moo Ping
description: Savory, chewy, and spicy, this dish is a flavorful interpretation of the Thai street food classic. Perfect for those seeking an adventurous and diabetic-friendly meal.
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the Dijon mustard, fish sauce, lime juice, and 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Add the garlic and chili peppers to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread 3-4 pieces of chicken onto each bamboo skewer.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large grill pan over medium-high heat.
Add the skewers to the grill pan and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Transfer the skewers to a serving platter and garnish with fresh cilantro.
